FN-L5GE8WY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 235
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/06/2026
House Bill 235 as introduced would appropriate $416,717,091 from the Education Trust Fund
(ETF) for fiscal year 2026 to certain agencies and entities to be used pursuant to the provisions
of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would appropriates $100,000,000 in gross income tax receipts from the
CHOOSE Act Fund to the Department of Revenue.

FN-L5GE8WY-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 235
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/11/2026
House Bill 235 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would appropriate
$419,717,091 from the Education Trust Fund (ETF) for fiscal year 2026 to certain agencies and
entities to be used pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would appropriates $100,000,000 from the CHOOSE Act Fund to the
Department of Revenue.
Finally, this bill would: (1) allow conversion charter schools receiving grant funds pursuant to
the FY 2024 ETF supplemental appropriations act (Act 2024-428) to use those funds as needed;
and (2) to amend the FY 2026 ETF Appropriations Act (Act 2025-270) to earmark $725,000 of
the appropriation for the Alabama Medicaid Education Consortium to the Decatur Morgan
Graduate Medical Education Program and decrease the earmark to Rural Alabama Teaching
Health Center by the same amount.

FN-L5GE8WY-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 235
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/01/2026
House Bill 235 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
appropriate $419,717,091 from the Education Trust Fund (ETF) for fiscal year 2026 to certain
agencies and entities to be used pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would appropriate: (1) $100,000,000 from the CHOOSE Act Fund to the
Department of Revenue; and (2) $312,835 from the Commission on Higher Education Fund to
the Commission on Higher Education.
Finally, this bill would allow: (1) conversion charter schools receiving grant funds pursuant to
the FY 2024 ETF supplemental appropriations act (Act 2024-428) to use those funds as needed;
(2) the Alabama Historical Commission to use any returned or unused funds previously
appropriated from the ETF for historical grants; and (3) amend the FY 2026 ETF Appropriations
Act (Act 2025-270) to earmark $725,000 of the appropriation for the Alabama Medical
Education Consortium to the Decatur Morgan Graduate Medical Education Program and
decrease the earmark to Rural Alabama Teaching Health Center by the same amount.
